name: updateLocationFieldAdvanced
description: Renames, retypes, reorders or changes the rules of an extra location field, using its id.

fieldId.description: The location field's id, as the plugin's settings give it.

newLabel.description: The field's new label; one another field already has is refused. Leave it out to keep the current label; it can't be removed.

newType.description: What the field holds; must fit its section. Leave it out to keep the current type; it can't be removed.

newRequired.description: Whether every location must fill it in. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

newAllowCustomLabel.description: Whether a location may show its own label for it. Leave it out to keep the current setting; it can't be removed.

newPosition.description: The field's new place within its section, counting from 1. Leave it out to keep its place; it can't be removed.

callback.description: Runs when it's done, with the updated field.

error.description: Why it didn't work, such as when the field can't be found or is ambiguous, nothing to change is passed, the new label is taken, or the type doesn't fit the section.

type.description: EMAIL, PHONE, URL, TEXT or RICH_TEXT.

required.description: Whether locations must fill it in.

allowCustomLabel.description: Whether a location may show its own label for it.
